description:
TaleCraft Prisons is a medieval prison server for Minecraft Bedrock.

Start as a Serf and mine your way up to God through 20 ranks, then Prestige for even bigger rewards.

- 27 mines with their own blocks for every rank

- Custom enchants (Common, Uncommon, Legendary) and Mana upgrades

- Crates: Vote, Common, Sacred, Mystery and Mythical

- Rent your own cell, join a clan and fight in the PvP arena

- Envoys, KOTH, Iron Guard and Drop Parties

- Auction House, Gambler, Bounties and MineBombs

- Daily missions and login rewards

Vote every day for a Vote Key, money and mana. Every 25 votes there is a Drop Party for everyone online!
